topic: Additional regional event discovery and actual occurrence of scheduled 28 October gatherings
description: Sixteen individual searches and three opened bodies did not establish an in-window qualifying gathering. A search-rendered schedule lists planned public events for 28 October, but announcement and expected headcounts are not proof they occurred; articles returned for health/justice leads were outside the period or documented workplace action rather than public assembly.
known_limits: No systematic region-by-region newspaper archive or LexisNexis review.
Search engine repeatedly returned March 2024 and 2026 material, including a 2026 Rumburk demonstration article.
A prior combined search response is preserved but cannot be aligned to individual query metadata; see raw_search/CZ24Q4-INITIAL-COMBINED-LOSS.json.
required_followup: Search post-event reporting for 28 October gatherings and regional/local protest activity in October, using fresh source assessments before any body request.
Check neighboring-month continuity and baseline later; do not infer no event from an empty candidate file.
